BiblicalUsage: Hazar-gaddah, the village of good fortune, is listed among the towns of southern Judah, beside Heshmon and Beth-palet. It is named once, in the allotment, with nothing more said of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the quiet towns of Judah are part of the inheritance too. Hazar-gaddah has no story, but it has a place in the land God gave.
